title: Bounded trimming computation
statement: For every pair of Boolean words $x,w$ and every position $i$ with $i\le |x|$, the designated Boolean Turing machine, started in state $1$ with input head at position $i+1$, work tape holding $w$ and head at $|w|-1$, and empty output, halts within $3(|w|+1)$ steps and has output equal to the prefix of $w$ strictly before its last true entry, or the empty word if $w$ has no true entry.
caveat: The referenced machine is not defined in the supplied formal snippet or informal definitions, so its role can only be described as the designated machine.
